decisive_items: Five days prior, her classmate had directed an online-bought handheld high-intensity LED light (30 chip-on-board LEDs emitting 5 W, 100 lm/W at 500 mA) at her right eye multiple times at very short distance with flash mode
Hyperreflective area at external retinal layers, disruption of ellipsoid zone, outer segment photoreceptor and interdigitation zone
Mosaic-like hyporeflective outer retinal space with flat RPE
response.rationale: Acute unilateral macular outer retinal injury after high-intensity LED exposure with ellipsoid/IZ disruption and subsequent restoration is diagnostic of phototoxic maculopathy; broader labels omit the causal mechanism or specific macular localization.

rejected.why: Identifies the phototoxic mechanism but omits the macular localization and is less complete than phototoxic maculopathy.
Optic neuropathy is contradicted by unremarkable anterior segment and fundus examination and by outer retinal OCT changes.
Retinal damage is too generic and does not capture the phototoxic macular mechanism.
Retinal recovery describes the follow-up course, not the diagnosis.
Retinal dystrophy is contradicted by acute onset, unilateral LED exposure, and progressive recovery.
Adds only anatomy to the generic retinal damage label and lacks etiologic and macular specificity.
